Created in 1993 by Roberto Ierusalimschy, Luiz Henrique de Figueiredo, and Waldemar Celes at the Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, Lua has gained popularity in recent years due to its simplicity, flexibility, and ease of use.

Lua's syntax is designed to be easy to learn and understand, with a focus on simplicity and readability. It has a small standard library, but it can be easily extended with the use of third-party modules and plugins.
